column3: Karens have been known to plague the world with their unrelenting, entitled bullshit. This Karen is no different.
Starting her morning routine of polite pep talks... followed by active listening.
[sarcastic] Turns out putting fish in the microwave is the cleaner's fault. Who knew.
Karen is told to see her boss. She reluctantly opens the laptop, and is immediately fired by A.I. Sean, who deems Karen and her H.R. department completely useless.
She smugly turns the laptop around to her boss. Turns out he's got the sack too.
Karen struggles to find empathy for someone she wants to defenestrate at the best of times...
In these moments, even atheists pray to Christ.
Karen, without a phone, has no idea what's happening. She heads out to find an ancient relic.
[serious] A phone booth.
Susan explains that A.I. Sean fired her, and that she dropped her phone in the river... and that she owes her for the bar tab.
She doesn't.
She has to do something. Call someone.
People like Susan lie in bed all day, doing nothing about AI taking everyone's jobs. Karen, well... she rolls her sleeves up and actually does something about it.
Enraged by the injustice of it all, Karen does what she does best. She speaks to the manager. In her head, that's any politician who'll listen. So she starts at the receptionist level.
Poor bastards.
I have ALL DAY to complain. Karen ain't fucking around.
[sarcastic] No one has stayed on hold this long. Guinness World Records weep at the sight of it.
She claims the souls of her victims. The vitriolic decay of their empty eyes fuels her bloodlust.
A.I. is taking our jobs. And you just sit there. Appalling.
She savours each syllable, inflicting psychological damage, exactly as she did at her old H.R. job.
A new day, a new dawn. Karen clutches the phone like a sniper... picking her shots.
Aaron, a musician and streamer, walks by. He hears Karen shout, "All day to complain", and it has a ring to it. A frequency only musicians can tap into. He samples it, and makes a song out of it.
[sarcastic] It shouldn't, but it goes viral. Terrible... bloody... A.I. slop song.
Now internet famous, people catch wind of her location.
Creepy.
Crowds start to form. People share the shitty song, like these two morons.
Nice train shot, though.
The morons head up to join the rest of the crowd. Karen completely oblivious, as usual.
She's made the news. Her anti-A.I. message is being repeated throughout the masses.
Late-night chat show writers are starved of content. Luckily, the intern has her ear to the ground, and suggests having Karen on to talk to the President of the United States of America.
They love the idea, and it'll help his attempt to gain votes by going on late-night talk shows.
[sarcastic] Who the fuck decides to vote that way. Anyway.
The interview with the President is going well. The host asks if he'd give Karen a call... and so he continues with the puppet show.
They talk about the rise of A.I. He patronises her on live television, to show dominance.
Karen, completely unfazed.
The screen in the studio suddenly flashes on.
[serious] It's A.I. Sean.
Next stop: getting fucked up with Susan. A.I. Sean sacked her this morning too. Two redundancies... one bar tab.
Stand clear of the closing doors, please.
They steal wine glasses, and head out to look over the river.
Lesson learned. Know your limit... and eat something. Get fucked up responsibly, folks.
Karen, let's get this A.I. mess sorted out. I'm going to put you in touch with my guy in England. He can pull a few strings.
Karen, is that you? I have an urgent message for you. For fuck's sake, listen. I have seen what happens if we do not take action... Christ, are you even there?!
She complained so much, she reached the final boss. [deadpan] And the final boss just got sacked.
